name: sql_db_schema
content:
CREATE TABLE television_viewership (
	year TEXT, 
	"2018" BIGINT, 
	"2019" BIGINT, 
	"2020" BIGINT, 
	"2021" BIGINT, 
	"2022" BIGINT, 
	"2023" BIGINT, 
	"2024" BIGINT
)

/*
3 rows from television_viewership table:
year	2018	2019	2020	2021	2022	2023	2024
Television viewership across India from 2018 to 2024 (in billion AMAs)	1604	1614	1731	1591	1474	1508	1530
*/

function.name: sql_db_query_checker
function.arguments:
{"query": "SELECT '2018' AS year, "2018" AS ama_billion FROM television_viewership
UNION ALL SELECT '2019', "2019" FROM television_viewership
UNION ALL SELECT '2020', "2020" FROM television_viewership
UNION ALL SELECT '2021', "2021" FROM television_viewership
UNION ALL SELECT '2022', "2022" FROM television_viewership
UNION ALL SELECT '2023', "2023" FROM television_viewership
UNION ALL SELECT '2024', "2024" FROM television_viewership
ORDER BY year::int;"}

Error: (psycopg.errors.FeatureNotSupported) invalid UNION/INTERSECT/EXCEPT ORDER BY clause
LINE 8: ORDER BY year::int;
                 ^
DETAIL:  Only result column names can be used, not expressions or functions.
HINT:  Add the expression/function to every SELECT, or move the UNION into a FROM clause.
[SQL: SELECT '2018' AS year, "2018" AS ama_billion FROM television_viewership
UNION ALL SELECT '2019', "2019" FROM television_viewership
UNION ALL SELECT '2020', "2020" FROM television_viewership
UNION ALL SELECT '2021', "2021" FROM television_viewership
UNION ALL SELECT '2022', "2022" FROM television_viewership
UNION ALL SELECT '2023', "2023" FROM television_viewership
UNION ALL SELECT '2024', "2024" FROM television_viewership
ORDER BY year::int;]
